packageRules.description: Cargo.toml names the exact version in use, and Cargo.lock pins it.
Everything arrives as one PR per schedule window. Files that must agree, such as rust-toolchain.toml, mise.toml, and the vcs image, update together.
openapi-typescript runs on the TypeScript 5 JavaScript API, which TypeScript 7 no longer has.
jsonwebtoken 10 needs aws-lc or the rsa crate, and vcs stays on ring until ADR 0002 replaces the token format.

customManagers.description: dprint plugins from npm. The exec plugin carries a checksum, so `dprint config update` updates it instead.
